text: New preprint: Learning to Evolve Scenes: Reasoning about Human Activities with Scene Graphs, with Francesca Pistilli and Giuseppe Averta.
Our team placed 2nd in the Ego4D Step Grounding Challenge at CVPR 2026 with HiERO-StepG.
I will participate in the ICCV 2025 Doctoral Consortium in Honolulu.
Our paper HiERO: understanding the hierarchy of human behavior enhances reasoning on egocentric videos was accepted at ICCV 2025.
I am presenting HiERO and Hier-EgoPack at the EgoVis Workshop and the Workshop on Visual Concepts at CVPR 2025.
I presented my research at the LTS4 lab, EPFL.
I am visiting the LTS4 lab at EPFL, working at the intersection between concept learning and video understanding under the supervision of Prof. Pascal Frossard.
Our journal article Egocentric zone-aware action recognition across environments was accepted at Pattern Recognition Letters.
